findings.issue: שה is one of the flock (sheep or goat); cordero resolves it to a young sheep.
Qal passive participle is stretched/extended; desigual substitutes unequal.
Feminine noun of spontaneity/freewill gift is smoothed to the bare adjective voluntaria.

notes: Conjunctions, 2ms harás, אתו, לנדֶר, and niphal לא יֵרָצֶה match.
